correctness.rationale: The Fano rank-three independence complex is the 2-skeleton of its line-avoiding cap complex, with 7 vertices, 21 edges and 28 allowed triangles. Every missing line boundary fills by permitted triangles, so ∂2 surjects onto rank15 graph one-cycle lattice; independent reconstruction gave rank(∂2)=15 and H2=Z13. The seven line-complement four-sets each have four allowed faces and their boundaries partition all 28 triangles into seven disjoint blocks; selecting one coordinate in each gives a unimodular 7×7 diagonal minor, certifying saturated rank7 inclusion and free rank6 quotient. At support<=4 every nonzero integral 2-cycle forms a tetrahedral boundary up to scalar; direct mod2 supports for sizes<=4 give exactly those seven, and integral edge cancellation fixes the scalar. Signed Lefschetz traces under GL3(F2) 168 elements produce characters (13,-3,1,1,-1,-1) and geometric (7,-1,1,-1,0,0), quotient (6,-2,0,2,-1,-1); their character norms are 1 and 2, consistent with known complex irreducibles. Inspected actual SymPy verifier and independently reconstructed face/boundary ranks and partition. All arithmetic finite and exact.
